data.define: Used to keep a mood happy and kind.

misuse.text: Don't say 'good vibes only' to someone sharing worries.
misuse.why: It tells them to hide feelings.

publish.title: What does "good vibes only" mean?
publish.value: Good vibes only = Only positive feelings here. Example: "Beach day, good vibes only!" (casual English).
